title: Vectors
unit: IAL Mechanics (M1) (unit inferred from file name)

questions.question: A particle A of mass 0.5 kg is at rest on a smooth horizontal plane. At t = 0 two forces F1 = (-3i + 2j) N and F2 = (p i + q j) N act on A. A moves in the direction of (i - 2j). Show that 2p + q - 4 = 0.
steps: A moves in the direction i - 2j, so R = lambda(i - 2j) for some scalar lambda

questions.question: Given that p = 5, find the speed of A at time t = 4 seconds, where A has mass 0.5 kg and starts from rest.
steps: v = u + at with u = 0 gives v = 16i - 32j m/s at t = 4
Speed = sqrt(16^2 + 32^2) = sqrt(1280) = 16 sqrt(5) m/s, about 35.8 m/s

questions.question: Ship A moves with constant velocity (3i + 12j) km/h, where i and j are unit vectors due east and due north. Find the speed of A.

At 12 noon ship A is at (-9i + 6j) km and ship B is at (16i + 6j) km, with B moving at constant velocity (pi + qj) km/h. At time t hours after noon the vector AB is [(25 - 12t)i - 9tj] km. Find the value of p and the value of q.
steps: Position of A at time t: (-9 + 3t)i + (6 + 12t)j
Position of B at time t: (16 + pt)i + (6 + qt)j

questions.question: Find the bearing of A from B when the ships are 15 km apart, giving your answer to the nearest degree.
steps: So t = 4/3 h, and at this time AB = 9i - 12j km
A from B = -AB = -9i + 12j, so the bearing = 360 - arctan(9/12) = 360 - 36.9 = 323 degrees

questions.question: The position vector r metres of particle P at time t seconds is r = (t - 3)i + (1 - 2t)j. Find, to the nearest degree, the size of the angle between r and the vector j when t = 2.
steps: To the nearest degree, theta = 162 degrees

questions.question: Find the values of t for which the distance of P from O is 2.5 m.
Particle P moves with constant acceleration (-4i + j) m/s^2. At t = 0 P has velocity (14i - 5j) m/s. Find the speed of P at t = 2 seconds.
steps: Speed = sqrt(36 + 9) = sqrt(45) = 3 sqrt(5) m/s, about 6.71 m/s

questions.question: Find the size of the angle between the direction of i and the direction of motion of P at time t = 2 seconds.
steps: theta = arctan(0.5) = 26.6 degrees, below the direction of i

questions.question: At time t = T seconds, P is moving in the direction of the vector (2i - 3j). Find the value of T.

Particle P (4 kg) is on a rough plane inclined at alpha with tan alpha = 3/4, and particle Q (m kg) is on a smooth plane inclined at beta with tan beta = 4/3. A light string passes over a small smooth pulley at the intersection of the planes, with the system in limiting equilibrium and coefficient of friction 1/4 between P and the first plane. Given that P is on the point of slipping down the first plane, find the value of m.
steps: sin alpha = 3/5, cos alpha = 4/5, sin beta = 4/5
Normal reaction on P = 4g cos alpha = 16g/5
Limiting friction on P (up the plane) = (1/4)(16g/5) = 4g/5
P (up the plane): T + 4g/5 = 4g sin alpha = 12g/5, so T = 8g/5
Q is about to move up its smooth plane: T = mg sin beta = 4mg/5

questions.question: Find the magnitude of the force exerted on the pulley by the string.
steps: Tension in the string T = 8g/5 in both parts
Part to P: direction (-4/5, -3/5); part to Q: direction (3/5, -4/5)
Resultant = T(-1/5, -7/5), magnitude = T sqrt(1 + 49)/5 = sqrt(2) T
Magnitude = sqrt(2)(8g/5) = 8 sqrt(2) g/5 N, about 22.2 N with g = 9.8

questions.question: Find the direction of the force exerted on the pulley by the string.
questions.answer: Vertically downwards, tilted about 8.1 degrees towards P
steps: Angle from the vertically downward direction: tan theta = 1/7
theta = 8.1 degrees, tilted towards P (to the left)

questions.question: At 7 am a ship leaves a port at (-2i + 9j) km and moves with constant velocity. At 7.36 am it is at (4i + 6j) km. Show that the velocity of the ship is (10i - 5j) km/h.
Find the position vector of the ship t hours after leaving port.
steps: Position = initial position + velocity x time

questions.question: At 8.48 am a passenger notices a lighthouse due east of the ship, and at 9 am the lighthouse is north east of the ship. Find the position vector of the lighthouse.
steps: 8.48 am is t = 1.8 h: ship is at (16i + 0j) km, so the lighthouse has y-coordinate 0 (due east)
9 am is t = 2 h: ship is at (18i - j) km
Lighthouse at (x, 0) relative to ship is (x - 18, 1), which is north east when its components are equal

questions.question: Find the position vector of the ship when it is due south of the lighthouse.
steps: Due south of the lighthouse (at x = 19) means the ship has x-coordinate 19
Position vector of the ship = 19i - 1.5j km

questions.question: A particle P of mass 2 kg moves under two forces (pi + qj) N and (2qi + pj) N, where p and q are constants. The acceleration of P is (i - j) m/s^2. Find the value of p and the value of q.
Find the size of the angle between the direction of the acceleration (i - j) and the vector j.
At time t = 0 the velocity of P is (3i - 4j) m/s. At time t = T seconds, P is moving in the direction of (11i - 13j). Find the value of T.
steps: Velocity at time t: v = (3 + t)i + (-4 - t)j

questions.question: Ship A moves with constant velocity (3i - 10j) km/h. At t = 0 it is at (13i + 5j) km. Find r, its position vector at time t hours, in terms of t.
steps: r = initial position + velocity x time

questions.question: Ship B moves with constant velocity (15i + 14j) km/h and is at (3i - 5j) km at t = 0. Show that at time t hours the vector AB = [(12t - 10)i + (24t - 10)j] km.
steps: Position of B at time t: (3 + 15t)i + (-5 + 14t)j
Position of A at time t: (13 + 3t)i + (5 - 10t)j

questions.question: Given that the two ships do not change course, find the shortest distance between the two ships.
steps: Minimum when d/dt(|AB|^2) = 1440t - 720 = 0, so t = 0.5 h

questions.question: Find the bearing of ship B from ship A when the ships are closest.
steps: At t = 0.5, AB = -4i + 2j, so B is 4 km west and 2 km north of A

questions.question: Particle P moves with constant acceleration. At t = 1 s P has velocity (-i + 4j) m/s, and at t = 4 s it has velocity (5i - 8j) m/s. Find the speed of P at t = 3.5 seconds.
steps: Speed = sqrt(16 + 36) = sqrt(52) = 2 sqrt(13) m/s, about 7.21 m/s

questions.question: Boat Q has velocity (20i - 20j) m/s. Find the direction in which Q is travelling, giving your answer as a bearing.
steps: Velocity (20i - 20j): 20 m/s east and 20 m/s south
This is the south east direction
Bearing measured clockwise from north = 180 - 45 = 135 degrees

questions.question: Boats P and Q move with constant velocities 15i m/s and (20i - 20j) m/s. At t = 0, P is at the origin O and Q is at 200j m. Show that the vector PQ = [5t i + (200 - 20t)j] m.
steps: Position of P: p = 15t i m
Position of Q: q = 200j + t(20i - 20j) = 20t i + (200 - 20t)j m

questions.question: Find the bearing of P from Q when t = 10.
steps: At t = 10: PQ = 50i + 0j, so Q is 50 m due east of P
So P is 50 m due west of Q
Bearing of P from Q = 270 degrees

questions.question: Find the distance between P and Q when Q is north east of P.
steps: North east means the components of PQ are equal and positive: 5t = 200 - 20t
Distance = sqrt(40^2 + 40^2) = 40 sqrt(2) m, about 56.6 m

questions.question: Find the times when P and Q are 200 m apart.
questions.answer: t = 0 s and t = 320/17 s, about 18.8 s

questions.question: A square floor ABCD of side 50 m has centre O, with i in the direction of AB and j in the direction of AD. Robot R is at (-2i + j) m at t = 0 and at (9i + 23j) m at t = 11 s, moving at constant velocity. Find, in terms of t, i and j, an expression for the position vector r of R.
Robot S leaves corner C at t = 0 with constant velocity (-i - j) m/s. Write down, in terms of t, i and j, an expression for the position vector s of S.
steps: C is at (25i + 25j) m relative to O (half the side length in each direction)

questions.question: Show that the vector SR = [(2t - 27)i + (3t - 24)j] m.
Find the time when the distance between R and S is a minimum.
Two forces F1 = (2i - 3j) N and F2 = (pi + qj) N act on particle A, where p and q are constants. The resultant of F1 and F2 is parallel to (i + 2j). Show that 2p - q + 7 = 0.
steps: R is parallel to i + 2j, so (q - 3) = 2(2 + p)

questions.question: Given that q = 11, the mass of A is 2 kg, and F1 and F2 are the only forces acting on A, find the magnitude of the acceleration of A.
steps: From 2p - q + 7 = 0 with q = 11: 2p = 4, so p = 2
